verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a prefunded Issuing balance that you top up by pushing funds from an external bank account (docs-9), so the prefunded model is clearly supported. Real-time authorization webhooks let your system approve or decline each authorization (docs-4), but nothing in the evidence shows your system funding each authorization just-in-time. That webhook is an adjacent control, not a funding model, and no comparison of funding options is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented just-in-time funding where your system funds each authorization, an explicit choice between funding models, and documentation of the cash-flow tradeoffs between them.
